description: External API action with Named Credential and complex response mapping

answers.what_it_does: Check real-time inventory availability for a product SKU across multiple warehouse locations. Returns quantity available, nearest warehouse, and estimated ship date.

inputs.name: productSku
inputs.description: The product SKU to check inventory for

inputs.name: customerZipCode
inputs.description: Customer zip code to find the nearest warehouse

outputs.name: quantityAvailable
outputs.description: Total quantity available across all warehouses

outputs.name: nearestWarehouse
outputs.description: Name of the nearest warehouse with stock

outputs.name: estimatedShipDate
outputs.description: Estimated ship date in YYYY-MM-DD format

outputs.name: inStock
outputs.description: Whether the product is currently in stock

outputs.name: errorMessage
outputs.description: Error message if the inventory check failed

answers.data_source: External REST API via Named Credential 'WarehouseAPI'. GET /api/v1/inventory/{sku}?zip={zipCode}. Returns JSON with warehouse locations array.
